title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1989
ACT VII OF 1989
PAKISTAN
INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st November, 1989]
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation
(Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Amendment of section 10, Act XIX of 1956

ACT VII OF 1989
ACT VII OF 1989
PAKISTAN
INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st November, 1989]
2. Amendment of section 10,
Act XIX of 1956.--In the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act,
1956 (XIX of 1956), in section 10,--
(a) in
subsection (1), the brackets and figure "(1)" shall be omitted; and
(b) subsections
(2), (3) and (4) shall be omitted.
